description: A tiny native macOS app for the AnkerMake M5 and M5C that does exactly three things: send a G-code file, show the printer's camera, and set or read nozzle and bed temperatures.
No slicer, no cloud dashboard, no account juggling beyond the one AnkerMake login. Drag a .gcode file onto the window, hit Send to printer, and watch the camera while it prints.
Pairs naturally with Springtail Slicer: slice there, send here.

download.label: Download for Mac
download.note: Unsigned build: right-click → Open on first launch.

features.body: Import or drag-and-drop a .gcode file; it uploads over your LAN and starts printing when the transfer completes.
features.title: G-code transfer

features.body: The M5's built-in camera at 720p / 25 fps, decoded with VideoToolbox.
features.title: Live camera

features.body: Nozzle and bed current and target temps, print state, progress, elapsed and remaining time, layer count.
features.title: Temperatures

features.body: Click either gauge to set a target, or turn a heater off. Last targets are remembered for Preheat. Works idle or mid-print.
features.title: Temperature control

features.body: Pause, resume, stop, preheat, home — right in the window.
features.title: Print control

name: EufyMake Sender
requirements: AnkerMake M5 or M5C on the same LAN
